description:
“Your empire is now like a tyranny: it may have been wrong to take it; it is certainly dangerous to let it go.” -- Pericles, History of the Peloponnesian War 2.63.

The Delian League was an alliance of Greek city-states formed in 478/477 BC under Athenian leadership to continue the war against Persia and defend the Aegean. Its treasury was originally kept on the sacred island of Delos, with member states contributing ships or tribute. Over time, Athens increasingly dominated the alliance, transferring the treasury to Athens and restricting members from leaving. By the mid-5th century BC, the League had effectively become the foundation of the Athenian maritime empire.
